--- PAGE 37 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_f27592f25735dbb599abfc4b7456]]

Problem: UIT Does Not Power Up
Description of Problem:
The UIT does not power.  Screen is blank and not lit up.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_947d51f261da7385a90f26b8ae11]]

Troubleshooting:
1.Touch the screen to see if it turns on.  If the machine sits
idle for a long period of time the touch screen goes into a
sleep mode to protect the screen.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_e22831cdebe6839af6ad76b9c98d]]

2.Make sure your cutting software is open on the cutting
system computer.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_0bc0f5466cbd79fd936d561bcf01]]

4.Find the black ethernet power supply (PoE) located next
to the computer. Verify the green LED is illuminated.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_d61890eff215dfd7fa35bf323f46]]

5.If there is no green LED lit, check the AC outlets located
on the back of the diagnostic cabinet. If there is no  AC
power, check the AC power cord and fuses F3 and F4 in
the diagnostic cabinet.

--- PAGE 37 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_11f51d423e19059ce033670970e1]]

Problem: Machine Stop during Cut Due to Uninten-

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_e7ab399832c11ef54e390daea7f7]]

tional pause
Description of Problem:
The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message
“Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch
Screen.  When pressing NEXT on the keypad, the machine
will continue to cut where it left off.  This is typically caused
by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_201c0ce49b778c1b93b726d9bea6]]

Troubleshooting:
1.Check stop disc activation. The stop discs should not
activate by a slight touch or vibration. They should activate
only when moved by minimum pressure. Remove gantry
side cover. Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger
to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease
activation pressure.

--- PAGE 37 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_196fa47b50fa841e8ce7e8765527]]

Problem: The buttons on the Touch Screen are out of

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_d7887ee0581296de410807888894]]

alignment
Description of Problem:
The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen
needs to be touched to activate the command.  Operator
needs to push above, below, right or left of the button for the
command to take effect.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_aa3ea730fc7828d4ec3d5a2713de]]

Troubleshooting:
Touch screen calibration in required. Proceed as follows.
1) Power down the cutting system.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_caf13ce088bc56543a8f21f14e1a]]

2) Place finger on the upper left corner of the touch screen as
Shown. While holding finger on the screen, turn ON the
main power switch located on the back of the diagnostic
control cabinet.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_d84fc3420cd8f56c63b8348a3b36]]

3) Remove finger after the "Power On Setup" screen appears.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_78e5afc499d4ecbca68472dedef3]]

4) Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the
Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen
to begin calibrating.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_b1669d9364a63e1a817497605f17]]

37
Form E-554

--- PAGE 38 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_04139011a1cc010f5d5ac176e818]]

5) Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the
cross as shown. The cross will reappear in the lower right
corner. Press the center of the cross.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_3e3bc0d9766ce77407d3f1d3aa63]]

6) Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to
complete calibration.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_345c7c6c76812582818b018f2b7f]]

The touch screen will restart in normal mode. Check for
proper screen operation and begin your normal start-up
procedure.

--- PAGE 38 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_ecb865820b2566d6525c06827304]]

Problem: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
Description of Problem:
The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file or
they are delayed coming down at the beginning of a cut.  This
can be caused by an electrical short, tool mapping in
software or a problem with the power supply.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_ba1081f434b8b2299ba474e54828]]

Troubleshooting:
1.Make sure the gantry Tools ON switch is turned on. This
can be verified by making sure the laser pointer is on.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_8c4ec439b8bbd46b286760d4a66f]]

2.Verify the mapping of your tools and layers are mapped
properly under each tool.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_4830377bba6021899cb0b372e300]]

a)Look at the tool bar at the bottom of the Cut window to

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_b85f4a1ead5406dfaad74aaaa74f]]

quickly verify tool and layer mapping.  If there is no Tool Bar
as shown, then click on “View” then click on “Layers” and
“Tools” in the main E-Suite menu.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_e3ae7780b376018019ffd3c991d7]]

b)If the layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_dbfb1dc3c993652b0abb12c18b03]]

tool holder then just click and drag the tool to the spindle
or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_bf30ecdcc340ad9180daca102b25]]

3.With E-Suite closed, check tool holder to see if it moves
freely and is not damaged or bent.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_94f157a21e3512327b594866eafc]]

4.Make sure you have pressure at the tools. Try pulling tool
the holder down by hand to see if it has pressure.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_b73f6df43ec949ed855fda1400f8]]

5.Check tool connections.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_565cf17ecd15d286a4f70ed7daf2]]

a) Hit the Cut Down button on the UIT to verify the

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_9717b5fa03cb12176d35fd7d2587]]

corresponding green LED light is on. Located on the slice
output cards (non-operator gantry side plate).

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_68a02d28eef4fb02a6248fb79878]]

b) Try firing the tool manually by pressing red button under

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_91059e3aa3c98ca5908808a06b82]]

solenoid block.  Each solenoid can be manually fired by
pressing the individual button.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_4493bc8c9e2bcbdcfd5e8dffe994]]

c) Check cable connection at air manifold for proper

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_90a1d0c1d5496ad00a6a38035462]]

connection.

--- PAGE 38 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_ecb865820b2566d6525c06827304]]

Problem: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
Description of Problem:
The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file or
they are delayed coming down at the beginning of a cut.  This
can be caused by an electrical short, tool mapping in
software or a problem with the power supply.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_6f1cf9ad56aa64fc68fd78329080]]

6.The Pen or Tool delays coming down and misses the
beginning of marker or cut.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_b096e08dd51396da3cc0c25cea48]]

a) Check the 24 VDC power supply located in the diagnos-

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_911e218baf74c4be2e711aa0aa5b]]

tic cabinet. Make sure the green led is on.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_9648c08869baf4438165f46bee3b]]

b) Check the 24 VDC power supply fuse.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_2b95e98a4c53381ba354aea33aac]]

c) Check flow control valves on the pen air cylinder.

--- PAGE 38 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_24e9f1f28280c15df5621a95b60d]]

Problem: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_bf0d22976074a36ab1dc13e98d99]]

or no vacuum.
Description of Problem:
An odor is present when cutting with the laser tool or Laser
cutting path is wider than normal

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_29f6379079602caa845c91278475]]

Troubleshooting:
1. Check the laser fume extractor for power and is turned ON.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_8485c00b8198bb52e1d34681d927]]

2. Increase vacuum pressure using the fume extractor
control panel.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_8f8c23f91dcf86623a0a4ad8458c]]

3) Replace vacuum filters.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_07f4f238a0d0db68c80dab9eeaa6]]

4) Clean vacuum hose and funnel.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_1e43bcbd22540a4c74f19f6e2808]]

38
Form E-554

--- PAGE 39 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_bee46367b4c8e6ff8b8aad08e639]]

Problem: Laser cutting path is too wide
Description of Problem:
The laser cutting path increases to an undesirable width.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_06e07db29353e62312217a4b6b52]]

Troubleshooting:
1. Check for damage to brass laser nozzle. Replace nozzle
if any damage is present.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_1efed30b6a1f6c22a6abac86ba33]]

2. Check for brass laser nozzle alignment. If the tube or
nozzle is bent,  the laser beam will reflect off the inside wall
of the nozzle causing a wide path. To verify, perform a test
pulse on a piece of card board.  If the dot has a ring or partial
ring around it, the nuzzle is bent or the mirrors may need
to be adjusted.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_671169a61272242beca8715e1014]]

3. Check laser power and cutting speed. Settings may vary
when changing materials. Testing will yield best results.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_5540253dca20701fb86ee54cfb5c]]

RF/EMI Interference
Some factory environments may have equipment that gener-
ates Radio Frequency (RF) or Electro-Magnetic Interference
(EMI). These signals in close proximity to the Eastman
cutting system can generate electrical noise and cause
problems for the machine and computer (Eastman does offer
a shielded mouse). It is recommended that any RF Welders
or other equipment generating RF or EMI noise be a mini-
mum of 75 feet (23 meter) from the Eastman cutting system.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_7556ebbc37cbe6a4bbaf02a7f7f8]]

Problems of this nature are typically difficult to resolve and
must be approached in a systematic manner. To reduce the
effects of electrical noise generated by RF, Eastman Ma-
chine Company has the following recommendations:

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_7a6d90a87a33b5ed6264f6accca3]]

Step 1) Install an earth ground as close as possible to the
transformer feeding AC power to the cutting system.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_bbd72fde66d41a74864899b0c3f3]]

Step 2) Enclose all AC power cables in rigid conduit and
secure to the earth ground. Route the four power cables for
the computer controls around the end of the conveyor instead
of under the unit.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_4537e6286d3f9cb69aca29c2d8a4]]

Step 3) Ground conduits to the table frames.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_ef82a2c6d53a8fac930d7fae57a7]]

Step 4) Implementation of the foregoing should reduce the
level of interference to a workable level. In the event that RF
is still determined an issue, installation of RF filters and/or
power line filters may be required.

--- PAGE 39 ---

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_2bdd4be1646e965e889e02d94a4f]]

Problem: Loss of laser cutting power
Description of Problem:
The laser cutting power decreases causing non-cut edges.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_370cc5da5f9972f2805d3360f31a]]

Troubleshooting:
1. Damaged or dirty lens. Check for damage or dirt on the
focusing lens. Clean or replace lens as required.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_8ae0e716bd50897524c47b465495]]

2. Damaged or dirty Mirror. Check for damage, burn mark or
dirt on the beam deflecting mirrors. Clean or replace
mirrors as required.

[[EVIDENCE_ID: ev_64a08ff4290d6177b6f8e298743f]]

3. Damage or debris in laser nozzle. Check for damage or
debris in laser nozzle. Clean or replace laser nozzle as
required.
